Lamar Bunting and Gene Neumeier caught a winning 9.12 pounds with five fish. Their best fish measured 2.37 pounds. (updated 10-29-2026) WestRock Landing in Roland (501-658-5598) reports that the front launch ramp and the back launch ramp were both temporarily closed due to the low water levels. As of last week, Lake Maumelle was down 12.17 feet below normal pool. The surface water temperature is 71 degrees.

(update 10-15-2026) Ray Hudson at River Valley Marina (501-517-1250) said the water is normal. The crappie have begun to bite again. They’ll bite at 3 feet on jigs — “probably can catch them on minnows, too,” Ray said, “but I’m only hearing about jigs.” Fish in 6 feet of water around the trees. Black bass are still biting. Cane Creek Lake is a 1,700-acre lake in Lincoln County that was built in 1986 and is owned and managed by the AGFC. It is stocked with bass, crappie, bream and catfish. Anglers are catching them on Bobby Garland Baby Shad on a white jighead, and Mercer said he's only seen people using jigs — no shiners.
